title: Random seeds are random again
summary:
Random-seed requests now produce fresh results, while mobile tables, API docs and recent news got tidied up.

Three fixes make `seed=-1` generate fresh text and images instead of repeating cached or deterministic results. Explicit image seeds, including `0`, keep their intended behavior.

API key and Pricing tables now scroll within their own containers on narrow screens, rather than dragging the whole page sideways.

The README and API references now point developers to `gen.pollinations.ai`. The regenerated reference adds a vision-request example and clarifies the `/v1/models` response format and model-restricted key behavior.
